websiteWikiPvp.title: PvP
websiteWikiPvp.description: Mantus is an open PvP world where the power you earn matters. Here is how player-versus-player damage works and where we are taking it.

formula.title: No Halved Damage
formula.body: Classic Tibia applies a PvP formula: damage dealt to another player is cut in half, so a hit that would deal 500 to a monster lands for only about 250 in PvP. Mantus removes that rule entirely — your attacks deal their full damage against players, the same as against monsters.

goal.title: Built for Real Duels
goal.body: Our goal is PvP where a 1v1 is genuinely worth fighting — and where high-level characters actually feel, and are, strong. The levels, skills, and gear you earn carry their full weight against other players.

balance.title: Ongoing Balance
balance.body: Removing the halving changes the shape of every fight, and we treat that as something to tune, not a side effect. We will keep balancing the game and the damage of every vocation toward strong, fair 1v1 PvP.

websiteWikiItems.title: Items & Rarity
websiteWikiItems.description: Equipment dropped by creatures has a chance to roll a rarity grade. Graded items carry affixes — random bonuses on top of the item's base stats. Higher grades roll more affixes, and every bonus rolls stronger.

rarities.title: Rarity Grades
rarities.description: Each graded drop rolls its affixes from the shared pool below, and an affix never repeats on the same item. Common is the baseline: the item's base stats with no rolled affixes.

affixes.title: Affixes
affixes.description: Every affix rolls a value inside its band, then scales it by the grade's affix power. The table shows the resulting roll range on each grade.

notes.attackSpeed: Capped at half of your vocation's base attack speed.
notes.lifeLeech: Heals you from auto attacks only.
notes.manaLeech: Restores mana from auto attacks only.
notes.skill: Boosts the weapon's own skill; rolls Shielding on non-weapons.
notes.magicLevel: Only rolls on Rare grade or better.
notes.resistance: Rolls one element: Physical, Energy, Earth, Fire, Ice, Holy or Death.

websiteVocations.title: Vocations
websiteVocations.description: Every hero begins with one of five vocations. Your choice defines the weapons you master, the magic you command, and the role you fill when danger closes in.

Knight.playstyle: Close the distance, hold dangerous creatures in place, and rely on melee weapons, armour, and a deep health pool.
Knight.strength: Durability, carrying supplies, and sustained close-range damage.
Knight.tradeoff: Limited ranged pressure and less offensive magic than other vocations.

Paladin.playstyle: Control distance with bows, crossbows, and spears while supporting each attack with healing and holy magic.
Paladin.strength: Flexible solo hunting, ranged damage, and balanced survivability.
Paladin.tradeoff: Ammunition, positioning, and distance skill all require steady preparation.

Sorcerer.playstyle: Shape fights with destructive fire, energy, and death magic, delivering powerful bursts before enemies can close in.
Sorcerer.strength: High spell damage, large-area attacks, and rapid elimination of groups.
Sorcerer.tradeoff: Low physical durability makes positioning and mana management essential.

Druid.playstyle: Keep allies alive with powerful healing while controlling enemies through ice, earth, and nature magic.
Druid.strength: Group support, recovery, crowd control, and elemental spellcasting.
Druid.tradeoff: Lower durability and damage that depends heavily on careful spell use.

Monk.playstyle: Fight at close range with disciplined fist techniques, deliberate positioning, and relentless physical pressure.
Monk.strength: Fist combat, mobility, and sustained brawling at close range.
Monk.tradeoff: Must stay near the target and pace aggression carefully in dangerous fights.

hero.tagline: A ruthless old-school world, forged anew
hero.subtitle: Mantus Online is a free classic-style 2D MMORPG: one persistent open world where every step, every trade, and every battle is real — and everything you earn can be lost.
hero.note: Free to play — runs in your browser
hero.artAlt: Key art of the world of Mantus

featured.label: Development Preview
featured.title: Beneath the Citadel, the Astral Vault Stirs
featured.description: Surveyors have found a sealed chamber beneath the northern citadel. This preview explores the kind of dangerous group expedition, layered environmental story, and server-authored encounter we are building for Mantus.
featured.imageAlt: Three adventurers stand before a glowing seal in an ancient underground vault

features.title: Forged for the Fearless
features.subtitle: Everything that made classic MMORPGs matter — rebuilt with modern craft and a server that never cheats.

world.title: A Living Open World
world.description: Explore a hand-crafted realm of cities, dungeons, and wilderness. Hunting grounds are contested, resources are finite, and the map remembers what you did.

combat.title: Classic Tactical Combat
combat.description: Position, timing, and preparation decide fights. Master melee, ranged, and elemental magic — and respect the creatures that are stronger than you.

economy.title: A Player-Driven Economy
economy.description: Every item is earned, traded, or crafted by players. Buy and sell on the market, bid at auctions, bank your gold, and own a house in the world.

social.title: Rise Together
social.description: Found guilds, form hunting parties, track friends with your VIP list, and carve your names into the history of the realm — or go to war over it.

vocations.title: Choose Your Path
vocations.subtitle: Five vocations, each with its own weapons, magic, and way of surviving the world. Choose wisely — mastery is a long road.

news.title: Chronicles of Mantus
news.subtitle: Dispatches from the developers and the world itself.

gatesOpen.title: The Gates of Mantus Open
gatesOpen.excerpt: The first world goes live. Create your free account, choose a vocation, and take your first steps into the realm.

marketAndHouses.title: Market Stalls & House Deeds
marketAndHouses.excerpt: The great market opens its doors and houses across the realm can now be bid on, owned, and furnished.

roadToWar.title: The Road to Guild Wars
roadToWar.excerpt: A look at what is coming next: guild banners, contested territory, and the systems that will decide who rules the wilds.

overview.title: One World. Countless Stories.
overview.description: Hunt through ancient forests, descend into forgotten ruins, trade what you recover, and build a name other players will remember. The realm is shared, persistent, and governed by the server — every victory is earned.
overview.imageAlt: A party of adventurers travels along a dark forest road toward a frontier watchtower
